# VibeOS development rules
Read docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, SECURITY.md, TESTING.md, tasks.json, assigned task and relevant contracts/ADRs. Repository is source of truth. Implement one assigned task only; mandatory dependencies must be VERIFIED. Inspect existing code; do not duplicate services or silently change contracts. Use strict TS and typed async Python. Do not execute generated code in host. All resource operations enforce ownership/capabilities. Add tests for each criterion and failure path; never disable or weaken tests. Record actual commands and exit codes. Implementation may mark IMPLEMENTED or BLOCKED only; verifier proposes VERIFIED after evidence and CI. Human approves merge. Do not start next task automatically. Run python scripts/progress.py --write after registry changes. No fabricated evidence.
